integrity: Exact all-order analytic proof supported by a separate rational checker for the finite witness. Historical priority is literature-bounded; no external certification.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to stationary post-unanimity binary edge environments with uniform vertex updates, known positive flip probabilities, known total vertex count and persistent observed edge labels; not a finite-sample reconstruction guarantee. The sharp witness is edge-labelled, not nonisomorphic as an unlabelled graph.
title: Third-order temporal edge statistics reconstruct fixed-strategy interaction networks
